notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard regional attribute-scope advisories. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, DDM FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies exact object and attribute sets for in-scope and out-of-scope transitions, suppression and release of both advisory callbacks under both callback models, and federation/region cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with regional attribute publication/subscription and FederateAmbassador attributesInScope/attributesOutOfScope delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and regional scope advisory declarations
